title: Expose native read-only Case Queue filters and deterministic sort through authorized HTTP
goal: Integrate the canonical CAP-INV-101 Class-0 status/owner/freshness filters and stable Case Queue sorting with the already-existing native authorized HTTP handler, preserving server authorization before filtering.
invariants: Only one native ProjectWithSavedViewFallback owns all filtering, sorting and tie-breaking; HTTP does not reproduce business predicates.
Every Case and nested Incident/Finding is independently authorized before any client-driven filtering or sorting.
Tenant/environment, permission/ACL, Saved View application, mutation, export and pagination controls are not accepted from HTTP query.
Host session, candidate provider, object authorizer, rate limiting, audit and TLS remain independent integrations; production not claimed.
security_properties: Unknown, duplicate, forbidden or malformed query parameters fail before session or provider access.
Each filter is one bounded valid UTF-8 literal and sorting is one allowed field/direction; client cannot choose tenant or owner permissions.
Foreign, missing, denied or unverified source records remain removed before projection, with no denied counts in response.
HTTP response remains no-store, no-referrer, Vary Authorization and <=4MiB.

migration.rationale: Read-only first-party HTTP adapter with host-supplied session, Case owner provider and authorizer; no canonical state mutation or persistence.

rollback.strategy: Revert optional HTTP query parsing while retaining original authorized GET q
verification: No Case data or Saved View mutation and parent SHA unchanged

inputs: E10-INV-101F verified native Case Queue core; E10-INV-101H-HTTP implemented first-party authorized read-only HTTP handler with exact-head security CI green but independent L2 pending.
CAP-INV-101 canonical read-only filters/sorting/permissions; existing ProjectWithSavedViewFallback Filter/SortSpec and stable tie breakers.
outputs: Native authenticated HTTP GET optional q/status/owner/freshness and single allowed sort field/direction mapped to existing projection.
Real HTTP tests for authorized multi-filter/sort, denied Case exclusion and invalid parameter fail-closed before resolving any authority.
acceptance_tests: GET q/status/owner/freshness/sort returns only Case rows visible to independently authorized principal, deterministically ordered by native engine.
Search and filters cannot see any denied Case/title, metadata or denied counts; object authorization executes before projection and filter matching.
Duplicate, malformed or forbidden tenant/saved-view/ACL inputs return generic HTTP 400 before provider/session; no new mutation/storage.
Exact-head required engineering CI PASS and independent material L2 before reviewable integration; preserve parent L2-frozen SHA.

performance_budget.rationale: Same <=5000 provider candidates and <=4MiB output, one authorized projection, constant count 5 params; native sort O(n log n).
metrics: <=5000 candidate Cases, <=4 MiB response, <=1024 encoded query bytes
One literal value per q/status/owner/freshness/sort, with 256/128 UTF-8 byte bounds
Single native deterministic sort after per-object authorizations

definition_of_ready: E10-INV-101F VERIFIED; native handler E10-INV-101H-HTTP IMPLEMENTED and engineering-kernel run #39238017552 SUCCESS on frozen SHA. Engineering dependency may use IMPLEMENTED to permit a child DRAFT, but merge acceptance awaits parent L2/approvals.
Read-only Case Queue HTTP filtering and sorting require no OPEN-013 Case mutation decision, no cursor contract or production IAM provider.
definition_of_done: Native server-owned Case Queue HTTP accepts bounded optional read-only filters/sort using ONLY existing projection.
Real HTTP security/function tests and exact-head CI evidence are recorded and independently reviewable.
Work graph retains IMPLEMENTED not VERIFIED until required gate/L2 and downstream approvals; parent/parallel PRs remain frozen.
